title: Classifier parity reference
description: reference.json written by the classifier reference generator; logits are in the sibling reference.safetensors as one float32 [cases, max_labels] tensor per oracle ("torch" required), padded with NaN beyond each case's label count. Not committed (derived from model weights, as in D26). See docs/design/classify.md.

corpus_sha256.description: hash of the classifier corpus, comment lines excluded, as D26

oracles.description: "torch" (fp32, required); optionally "fp16", the model's outputs in ideal fp16 (the conversion library's simulation), which the suite grades each path's ratio against

query.description: text-ranking: the query the document is paired with

group.description: text-ranking: the (query, documents) group; rank flips are counted within a group

type_ids.description: text-ranking: segment ids, for models whose graph takes token_type_ids

gold.description: gold labels when the corpus has them (reported, never graded)
